description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Sooriyapaluwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District (7836)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations, amendments to land parcel details (including parcel numbers, extents, and servitude rights), and modifications to land records under the Registration of Title Act. It focuses entirely on land and property matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories like legal frameworks or commercial activities.
